title: Loved Circus
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Office worker Kei loses his savings trying to pay off the debts of a hostess he loves, who has exploited him, and attempts suicide (TOKYOPOP blurb via AniList; Anime News Network review). He wakes in Circus, a brothel for gay male clients, and agrees to work there to repay his debts, living alongside workers such as Shiro and Joe, each with his own reasons for being there. A one-volume adult drama with romance.
life_message: Goodness can come from unexpected people, and a person at rock bottom can begin again (MangaUpdates blurb: 'My heart depends on goodness, wherever it may come from').

content.note: Dangerous clients and an accident and injury (MangaUpdates); not graphic per ANN.
Loan sharks, stalker and dark backstories; ANN calls the tone dark and gritty.
Set in a male brothel (all sources); ANN notes a 'surprising lack of detailed sex scenes'; MangaUpdates lists threesome, sadomasochism; retailers list it as Mature.
